high_level_description: This image depicts a close-up of an intricately carved terracotta statue, likely of a deity or a mythological figure, placed on top of a similar terracotta pot. The statue is reddish-brown in color and features detailed carvings, including a headdress with circular patterns, a long trunk, and multiple arms holding various symbolic items. The pot beneath the statue is also ornately designed with circular motifs and appears to be filled with water, as there are some leaves floating on the surface.
